title: Enterprise Connectivity: issuance undiscounted transfer subtotal
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this issuance undiscounted transfer subtotal rule to net transfer invoice.

## Basis: undiscounted subtotal
For net transfer invoice, subtract the source tier monthly included outbound transfer from that period quantity and floor at zero, then multiply by its standard unit price; this gives the undiscounted transfer subtotal.

## Basis Q&A
| Net transfer invoice basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Net transfer invoice: Subtract the source tier monthly included outbound transfer from that period quantity and floor at zero, then multiply by its standard unit price | this gives the undiscounted transfer subtotal. |

## Hypothetical transfer subtotal
For a hypothetical net transfer invoice, take monthly volume of 42 GB, included transfer of 20 GB and unit price USD 0.13. The excess is 22 GB, producing an undiscounted subtotal of USD 2.86. A hypothetical volume of 18 GB instead produces zero after the volume floor.
